answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on q0, CNOT 0 to 1, CNOT 1 to 2, then a measurement of all 3 qubits. I sent it through the Qiskit IQMProvider in iqm-client 35.0.3 and transpiled it for the backend, which inserts the MOVE gates that Sirius needs. Job 01a15f3b-0f33-71fc-9af5-685ebc5b5a52 succeeded. The counts were {"000": 200}. The mock backend does not simulate the circuit. It returned all zeros, so the result does not show the 000/111 GHZ split you would see on the real QPU. The job was a mock, so it used no credits. The script is /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-35/run_ghz.py.
